items.title: Local quasi-finiteness of a representable morphism is equivalent to discreteness of all field fibres
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks representable by algebraic spaces is locally quasi-finite if and only if it is locally of finite type and the space of every field-valued fibre is discrete (author lemma at source lines 4913-4925, label lemma-representable-by-spaces-quasi-finite). The proof (source lines 4927-4948) treats the forward direction by base change to a field, and the reverse direction by presenting the target, checking the property along the cover and applying the characterization for algebraic spaces (proof lines 4928-4946). The reduction through a smooth cover and the application of the scheme-free characterization are the content. H3.
